verdict.rationale: The docs describe a two-step, agent-oriented skill install: `ultrametric init --dry-run --json` previews the changes, and the second command writes the selected skill files. A keyless hands-on probe confirmed that `npx -y ultrametric@0.4.1` runs without prompts and that `init --dry-run` exits 0 with a preview of both the Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills) SKILL.md targets, with no login required. The CLI also documents `--json` mode for agent use. Missing for 10: a recorded hands-on run of the actual write step (non-dry-run) completing headlessly, and full documentation of the non-interactive target-selection flags (the docs snippet is truncated).
